description: AGSC-06-42: /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (the AI Catalog draft, specVersion "1.0", ai-catalog.io/spec, read 2026-10-29 — a draft, not a standard, and not in the IANA well-known registry) is emitted only when discovery.ai_catalog is true. The file is {"entries":[…],"specVersion":"1.0"} in JCS form with one trailing LF; an entry has identifier (urn:air:<host>:knowledge:<bundle.id>, and urn:air:<host>:a2a:<bundle.id> for the card), displayName, type (the media type the discovery document is served with, parameter included; application/a2a-agent-card+json for the card), url, description and digest, written sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes served at url; entries are in identifier order, so the card entry (a2a) comes before the discovery entry (knowledge). Four cases: the switch on without a card; with a card; the switch off (no file); the switch on with a host that is not a fully qualified domain name (rejected at build, AGSC-E209). The digests are the SHA-256 of the two byte strings of the input. Derived by hand.
